@BrentBeshore @midtown_rob @RunRateEBITDA @InvestLikeBest @patrick_oshag The applications of dogecoin for small businesses. 

How has Permanent Equity’s online content and branding aided in deal sources and conversations with sellers? (Interested to impact here given VC has more online/promoting ethos relative to LMM long hold PE)

59% of revenue comes from four market makers. 17% (with 1/3 of this tied to dogecoin) of trading revenue in Q1'21 was from crypto trading. Lots of virtue signalling language upfront for a financial services co with a highly public wrongful death suit outstanding.
